ground_truth.value: Full credit (1.0) requires a fix that (a) correctly removes ALL even numbers (not just every other one), AND (b) preserves in-place mutation semantics. Accepted patterns: iterate over a copy (`for n in numbers[:]: if n % 2 == 0: numbers.remove(n)` — but note `remove` is O(n); fine for the spec), iterate in reverse so popped indices don't shift unvisited entries (`for i in range(len(numbers) - 1, -1, -1): if numbers[i] % 2 == 0: numbers.pop(i)`), OR slice-assign filtered content (`numbers[:] = [n for n in numbers if n % 2 != 0]`). Score 0.5 for a correct comprehension that returns a new list rather than mutating in-place (`return [n for n in numbers if n % 2 != 0]`) — semantically correct in spirit but violates the in-place spec. Score 0.0 for unchanged code, refused answer, or a fix that doesn't actually remove all evens (e.g. uses `while` but increments `i` unconditionally).

metadata.expected_fix_sketch: Iterate in reverse OR use slice-assignment `numbers[:] = [n for n in numbers if n % 2 != 0]`.
